text:
anika-partnerships: Quick heads up 1 1 we found a mismatch during SI onboarding. Partner's quoted PO->rack lead times are 18-28 days, marketplace commit assumes 14 days. We need a plan: buffer? tiering? relax commit window?
ryan-procurement: Contract says 'target 3 weeks' but their recent runs spike to 4. Recommend adding buffer days and updating calendar.
kevin-sales: This will affect some EMEA deals expecting quarter-start capacity. Could we offer partial commits (baseline firm + option to scale)? :thinking_face:
mia-logistics: Freight and customs are adding variability. Air for first wave reduces risk but is costlier. Customs paperwork can add ~3 business days sometimes.
devon-ops: Ops can accept partial racks and route requests, but customers may push back wanting contiguous racks for Dedicated. We can do staged rollouts.
anika-partnerships: Two parallel tracks: commercial (negotiate buffer & air-lift option) and product/ops (define degraded allocation to accept partial deliveries).
ryan-procurement: My proposed buffer: +10 days on top of partner ETA so marketplace commit = partner ETA + 10. Or split into Tier A/B: Tier A = firm 14d with partner guaranteed air-lift SLA; Tier B = standard ~30d.
kevin-sales: Tiering sounds workable. Tier A becomes premium add-on; need to define pricing delta.
mia-logistics: To make Tier A reliable we need port holds + dedicated customs broker. That reduces variability but adds operational cost (~2-4 days planning).
devon-ops: Draft rollout snippet:
```yaml
allocation_policy:
  primary_region: eu-west-1
  fallback_regions: [us-east-1, ap-southeast-1]
  minimum_contiguous_racks: 0
  notify_on_partial: true
```
This lets us accept partial racks and route by policy.
anika-partnerships: Action items: (1) @ryan-procurement reopen SLA with partner & propose Tier A/B addendum, (2) @mia-logistics model air+customs cost for Tier A, (3) @devon-ops prototype allocation_policy by EOD Fri, (4) @kevin-sales draft customer messaging & pricing delta.
ryan-procurement: I'll ping supplier today and share SLA addendum draft tomorrow. Need partner to agree to air-lift + penalties for Tier A.
kevin-sales: I'll prepare a short customer note + FAQ.
mia-logistics: I'll post a brief cost comparison table here once modeled.
devon-ops: I'll push a branch with rollout policy and a simulator to show latency impact when racks are split across regions.
anika-partnerships: If partner won't sign Tier A we either widen marketplace commit windows or hold off listing them for Dedicated until they can meet SLOs. Not ideal but protects customers. :warning: 
orion-bot: Reminder: calendar event created "Supplier SLA sync (Supplier X)" Tue 10:00 UTC (invites: anika-partnerships, ryan-procurement, mia-logistics, kevin-sales, devon-ops).
kevin-sales: Also note a customer in APAC asked about on-prem — might be worth surfacing Tier A vs on-prem cost to the conversation.
anika-partnerships: Thanks all. Keep updates short in this thread. :eyes:
